items.html: Still another reason is needed for what is said in the Idra de Haazinu: that there is in her only the illumination of two Mochin alone. And the matter is in what was explained above, concerning the Tefillin of the head: that the Daat of ZA is comprised of the two coronets, which are Hassadim and Gevurot drawn from the brain of Daat of Aba and Ima, which spread in their body and in their six extremities, and are not from the Daat in the head itself of Aba and Ima — unlike the two Mochin of Hochma and Bina, which are drawn from the brain itself of Aba and Ima.
